READING
Removing a whole FUNCTION costs more than removing the same number of perturbations at random.
Each functional class carries response directions the other classes do not span. An oracle with
the true response in hand cannot rebuild a held-out class from the rest -- so no mapping from
annotations to coefficients can either. A compositional model does NOT exist for this data;
the constraint is coverage of function space, not architecture.
